Choose a weight class of Bearkin War Helm.

{{Flavor|The chosen helm is used for crafting Janthir Wilds legendary items. You must select a weight to use it in the Mystic Forge. Remnants can be purchased from renown heart vendors in Janthir Syntri.}} | type = Container | rarity = Exotic | bound = Account | collection = Legendary Weapon: Klobjarne Geirr Gifts | id = 102814 | requires = jw }} == Acquisition == {{achievement list|reward=Bearkin War Helm Choice Box}} == Contents == * Choice of one of the following: ** {{contains|Valkyrie Bearkin War Helm (medium)|chance=choice}} ** {{contains|Valkyrie Bearkin War Helm (light)|chance=choice}} ** {{contains|Valkyrie Bearkin War Helm (heavy)|chance=choice}} == Used in == * The helm in this container can be used to craft [[Nyr Hrammr]]. {{recipe list|Valkyrie Bearkin War Helm (heavy)}} == Notes == * After being destroyed or used in a recipe, [[Bearkin War Helm Remnant]] with the same Mystic Forge functionality can be bought from renown heart vendors in [[Janthir Syntri]]. * This item was renamed to Bearkin War Helm Choice Box from Bearkin War Helm and had its description updated with the [[Game updates/2025-06-24|June 24, 2025 game update]]. * Picking one armor piece unlocks the skins for all three armor weight classes.
